payload.message: I would like a human colleague to take over my account question. Please arrange follow-up and tell me what happens next.

response.answer:
I've passed your request to a human colleague. Your escalation reference is **1**, and its status is **queued**.

**What happens next:**
- A human support agent will pick up your case in the order it was received.
- They'll have a summary of this conversation, so you won't need to repeat your details.
- The agent will contact you through the channels registered on your account.

I don't have a timeframe for when an agent will respond, so I can't promise one. If you have more detail on your account question, you can add it now and I'll include it in the handover.
